# PLAN — iteration 1

## Current state assessment

The incumbent uses 328 LUTs, 54 FFs, no DSP48s, and meets timing with WNS 0.108 ns and WHS 0.24 ns. The editable top is only a wrapper around a frozen core, so forwarding that instance unchanged cannot reduce LUT use; the top must inline the arithmetic to make a targeted implementation change. The current top latency is known to be 2 cycles, requiring `// @latency 2`.

## Hypothesis

Mapping the four 8×8 products to DSP48E1 blocks should reduce LUT use while preserving the two-stage, one-result-per-cycle pipeline, with timing closure as a required check.

## Instruction for generator

Replace the child instance with equivalent top-level logic and apply Vivado’s `use_dsp = "yes"` directive to the four unsigned 8×8 product expressions, targeting four DSP48E1s instead of LUT multipliers. Keep both 17-bit pair sums captured in stage 1 and the 18-bit final sum captured in stage 2; preserve the ready/valid equations, synchronous active-high reset behavior, stall holds, and cycle behavior. Retain the matching `// @latency 2` annotation and verify all gates, especially routed LUT count and setup/hold timing.
